task_completion.description: Open the Nx Witness application and locate the 'Walkway Camera'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Nx Witness client interface is visible with 'Walkway Camera' listed in the resource tree or active in the viewing grid.

task_completion.description: Review the footage to identify unauthorized objects (bicycles, carts, skateboards).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent is seen scrubbing through the timeline or playing the video where non-pedestrian objects are visible on the walkway.

task_completion.description: Create bookmarks named 'Zone Violation' for the duration of the unauthorized entries.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Add Bookmark' dialog or the bookmark list shows entries with the exact name 'Zone Violation' and specific start/end time spans on the timeline.
A text editor (like Gedit or Mousepad) or a terminal 'cat' command shows a file being saved to the path /home/ga/violation_report.txt.

task_completion.description: Document the timestamps and object types in the report.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The content of /home/ga/violation_report.txt is visible and contains a list of timestamps corresponding to the video anomalies and the type of vehicle (e.g., bicycle, skateboard).

integrity.description: The agent used the Nx Witness GUI to identify violations and create bookmarks rather than just writing the report.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Nx Witness timeline, right-clicking to add bookmarks, or using the bookmark management menu.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy a pre-existing report file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen manually typing or formatting the report content based on the observations made in the video software.

integrity.description: The agent actually played or scrubbed the video to find the specific timestamps.
integrity.visual_evidence: The playhead in the Nx Witness timeline moves to different positions where unauthorized objects appear in the camera view.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task uses the UCSDped2 dataset. The camera name must be 'Walkway Camera'. Bookmarks must be named exactly 'Zone Violation'. The report must be saved to /home/ga/violation_report.txt. Unauthorized objects in this specific dataset typically include bicyclists, small carts, and skateboarders appearing on the pedestrian path.
